Version: 0.1.0. Local package for reproducible installation without private GitHub access.
Local adaptation: one soft sea-teal PAL_TIDE palette with mint highlights in src/palettes.js and src/index.d.ts; optional transparent palette rendering in src/index.js and src/shaders.js so the host theme supplies the track background. The transparent branch uses a short, gentle left fade to retain pigment at low progress. All operation states share the same cloud color. Preserve these changes when updating upstream. Original palette rendering remains opaque.
